name: lode
description: Durable per-repo project memory (a lode), a pre-PR gate that reviews the branch diff with fresh-context agents against the repo's own rules and learnings, and the shared engineering workflows (lfg, review-pr, finish-prs, debug-flaky, tdd, plan) that read a per-repo profile instead of being copied into every repository. The gate, lfg, review-pr, finish-prs and plan spend review tokens per the profile's Rigor tier (critical, standard or light, per path).
